rule.name: LockOrderInversion
rule.message: This nesting takes two locks of the class in the opposite order to another nesting of the class: two threads that run both can each hold one lock and wait forever for the other, a deadlock that no test reliably shows. Take nested locks in one order everywhere in the class (if any path takes a and then b, no path takes b and then a), or guard the state with one lock. Only locks held in fields of the class, this, Type.class and Type.FIELD are compared; a lock passed in, held in a local or taken in a called method is not followed.
